meta.title: Cleveland County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Cleveland County's 2026 budget ordinance (No. 2025-12), passed December 1, 2025 and filed with the state. We use the amounts the ordinance sets for each office and fund. The ordinance also moves $6,000 from County General to fund 3026 and $45,137 from the Ambulance Service fund to County General; those transfers are printed outside the totals shown here.
